title: GATE Physics Topic Test: General Aptitude — Set 2
titleEn: GATE Physics Topic Test: General Aptitude — Set 2

questions.questionTextEn: Pointing to a photograph, Rohan says, 'She is the daughter of my grandfather's only son.' How is the girl related to Rohan?
questions.explanationEn: Rohan's grandfather's only son is Rohan's father, and his daughter is Rohan's sister.

questions.questionTextEn: Despite the _______ evidence supporting the hypothesis, the committee requested an independent replication.
questions.explanationEn: 'Despite' signals contrast: requesting replication contrasts with 'compelling' (strong) evidence.

questions.questionTextEn: Neither the principal investigator nor the doctoral fellows _______ willing to compromise on calibration accuracy.
questions.explanationEn: In a 'neither...nor' construction, the verb agrees with the nearer subject ('doctoral fellows', plural), so 'were' is grammatically correct.

questions.questionTextEn: What is the greatest 3-digit number divisible by 12?
questions.explanationEn: $999 = 12 \times 83 + 3$, so the greatest 3-digit multiple of 12 is $999 - 3 = 996$.

questions.questionTextEn: Fill in the blank: The experimental setup, along with its auxiliary cooling coils, _______ inspected before every run.
questions.explanationEn: Phrases introduced by 'along with' do not change the grammatical number of the singular subject 'setup', so 'is' is correct.

questions.questionTextEn: A pipe fills a tank in 6 hours and a drain empties it in 10 hours. If both are opened together when the tank is empty, how many hours will it take to fill the tank?
questions.explanationEn: Net fill rate = $\frac{1}{6} - \frac{1}{10} = \frac{5 - 3}{30} = \frac{2}{30} = \frac{1}{15}$ tank/hr, so it takes 15 hours.

questions.questionTextEn: Choose the best word: Because the sample was extremely _______, even gentle vibrations shattered the crystal.
questions.explanationEn: 'Brittle' describes a solid that fractures easily under stress or vibration.

questions.questionTextEn: The spectrograph _______ calibrated twice before the eclipse began.
questions.explanationEn: An action completed before another past event ('before the eclipse began') requires the past perfect passive 'had been'.

questions.questionTextEn: Reflecting the point $(5, -2)$ across the line $y = x$ yields:
questions.explanationEn: Reflection across $y = x$ swaps the coordinates: $(x, y) \mapsto (y, x)$, mapping $(5, -2)$ to $(-2, 5)$.

questions.questionTextEn: Find the odd one out in the sequence: $8, 27, 64, 100, 125, 216$.
questions.explanationEn: All terms except 100 are perfect cubes ($2^3, 3^3, 4^3, 5^3, 6^3$); 100 is a square ($10^2$), not a cube.

questions.questionTextEn: In a class of 40 students, Priya ranks 14th from the top. What is her rank from the bottom?
questions.explanationEn: Rank from bottom = $40 - 14 + 1 = 27\text{th}$.

questions.questionTextEn: Three mutually tangent circles of radius $r = 1\text{ cm}$ each touch pairwise externally. What is the area of the triangle formed by joining their three centers?
questions.explanationEn: The centers form an equilateral triangle of side $2r = 2\text{ cm}$. Area = $\frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}(2^2) = \sqrt{3}\text{ cm}^2$.

questions.questionTextEn: Select the option that best fills the two blanks: Although the initial simulations appeared _______, deeper scrutiny revealed a _______ boundary-condition error that invalidated the projections.
questions.explanationEn: 'Although' requires contrast between appearing 'flawless' and harboring a 'subtle' error that invalidated the projections.

questions.questionTextEn: Six people P, Q, R, S, T, U sit in a circle facing the center. P sits opposite T. Q sits to the immediate right of P. S sits to the immediate left of T. Who sits to the immediate left of Q?
questions.explanationEn: Facing the center, if Q is to the immediate right of P, then P is immediately to the left of Q.

questions.questionTextEn: In a tournament of 8 players, every player plays every other player exactly once (round-robin). How many total matches are played?
questions.explanationEn: Total matches = $\binom{8}{2} = \frac{8 \times 7}{2} = 28$.

questions.questionTextEn: How many triangles of all sizes are formed when all diagonals of a regular pentagon are drawn? (Specifically, consider a simpler figure: a square with both diagonals drawn. How many total triangles are formed inside a square with both diagonals drawn?)
questions.explanationEn: There are 4 small right triangles formed by the diagonals meeting at the center, plus 4 larger right triangles formed by pairs of adjacent small triangles (split by each diagonal). Total = $4 + 4 = 8$.

questions.questionTextEn: In a group of 50 people, 30 speak English, 25 speak Hindi, and 10 speak both. If one person is picked at random, what is the probability that they speak NEITHER language?
questions.explanationEn: People speaking at least one = $30 + 25 - 10 = 45$. Neither = $50 - 45 = 5$. Probability = $5/50 = 1/10$.

questions.questionTextEn: Identify the sentence with NO grammatical error.
optionsEn: Had the vacuum seal held, the beam would have reached full luminosity.
If the vacuum seal would have held, the beam reached full luminosity.
Had the vacuum seal hold, the beam would reach full luminosity.
Were the vacuum seal held, the beam would have reached full luminosity.
questions.explanationEn: Option A uses the standard inverted third conditional ('Had + subject + past participle, subject + would have + past participle').

questions.questionTextEn: A boat travels 24 km upstream in 4 hours and 24 km downstream in 2 hours. What is the speed of the stream?
questions.explanationEn: Upstream speed = $24/4 = 6\text{ km/h}$; downstream speed = $24/2 = 12\text{ km/h}$. Stream speed = $(12 - 6)/2 = 3\text{ km/h}$.

questions.questionTextEn: A right cylinder of height 10 cm and circumference 24 cm has a string wound tightly around its curved surface exactly ONCE from the bottom edge to the point directly above it on the top edge. What is the minimum length of the string?
questions.explanationEn: Unrolling the lateral surface into a $24 \times 10$ rectangle makes the string its diagonal: $\sqrt{24^2 + 10^2} = \sqrt{576 + 100} = 26\text{ cm}$.
